evals.prompt: I need a ToR for a consultancy to redesign our MA data-quality training package. Budget ceiling around EUR 9,000 incl VAT from two funding sources, contract needs to be signed by mid-October, final products end of February. Build me a draft ToR.
evals.expected_output: Intake questions batched first (missing critical facts), then a branded docx ToR emitted via a python-docx generator saved alongside it, with every open-market checklist item either applied or flagged as a decision for Ane.

evals.prompt: Review this ToR before I send it to procurement — projects/tor-drafts/service-contract-tor-v0.2.md. Give me strong and weak points and a grade.
evals.expected_output: Read-only two-lens review (senior acquisition + topic expert), strong/weak points against the open-market checklist, a 1-10 grade with a self-grading bias note and a recommendation for an external read.

evals.prompt: We agreed revisions on the ToR yesterday: bulk budget figure instead of the split, add a Q&A window, page cap of 10 on proposals. Apply them to the v0.3 generator and re-emit the docx.
evals.expected_output: Scope-bounded edits to the generator source via Edit (edit-preservation protocol), docx regenerated, out-of-scope observations reported separately, nothing else changed.
